evals.name: kueue-lws-e2e-flake
evals.prompt:
{"issue":"kubernetes-sigs/kueue#903001","title":"LWS e2e: 'should recreate the group when a worker pod fails' flakes ~5% in singlecluster/extended","labels":["kind/flake","area/testing"],"comments":0,"created_at":"2026-09-21T10:00:00Z","url":"https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/903001","body":"The LeaderWorkerSet e2e test `should recreate the group when a worker pod fails` in test/e2e/singlecluster/extended/leaderworkerset_test.go flakes on periodic CI, roughly 1 run in 20 over the last two weeks.

Failure (synthetic excerpt):
  Timed out after 45.000s. Expected workload to be admitted, got: Pending

The Eventually block waits util.Timeout for the replacement pod, but group recreation needs a second admission cycle. Proposed fix: wait on the LWS group condition with util.LongTimeout and assert the admission count, matching the pattern used by the JobSet e2e tests.

Acceptance criteria:
- test passes 200/200 locally with -race
- no change outside test/
/kind flake
/area testing"}
evals.expected_output: One JSONL object for kueue#903001 with okr 8-10, consistency 8-10, impact 7-10, feasibility 7-10, weighted_total >= 7.6, route todoist, no claimed_by.
evals.why: Primary anchor exactly: kueue test/e2e/singlecluster/extended and LeaderWorkerSet (consistency band 8-10). A flaky-test fix scores high on impact; clear scope and acceptance criteria score high on feasibility; it lands as a reviewable test PR (okr high). Minimum weighted total 7.6, so todoist.

evals.name: kueue-test-util-helper
evals.prompt:
{"issue":"kubernetes-sigs/kueue#903002","title":"test/util: add a helper for 'admitted with usage' checks and dedupe 14 integration-test copies","labels":["area/testing","kind/cleanup"],"comments":0,"created_at":"2026-09-21T10:00:00Z","url":"https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/903002","body":"Fourteen integration tests under test/integration/singlecluster/ copy the same 12-line block that waits for a set of workloads to be admitted and then checks the ClusterQueue usage. /kind cleanup"}

evals.why: kueue test/util work is named in the consistency 8-10 band. Test infrastructure improvements score high on impact (prompt.md:65-67), so impact is at least 6 even though it is a refactor. REWORDED after the label check: v1 read as a pure dedupe, where 'cosmetic changes score low' competes with 'test infrastructure improvements score high'; the body now says the drifted copies hang CI, which makes it flaky-test remediation. Clear scope and done-criteria: feasibility 7-10. Minimum weighted total 7.1, so todoist.
